`UnifiedActivationPipeline` in `.aios-core/development/scripts/unified-activation-pipeline.js` activates all 12 agents; `generate-greeting.js` delegates via `UnifiedActivationPipeline.activate(agentId)`. Pipeline: five parallel loaders, agent definition, sequential preference/session/workflow, enriched context, `GreetingBuilder`. `loadUserProfile()` runs in `buildGreeting()` and is passed to `_buildContextualGreeting()`. `GreetingPreferenceManager.getPreference(userProfile)` restricts bob mode except PM; non-PM auto redirects, forced named gives simple greeting and no commands. Eight agents define `visibility: [full, quick, key]`; qa, data-engineer, devops, ux-design-expert lack it and fall back to first 12 commands; aios-master uses `visibility: full`.

When mocking `resolveConfig`, use `mockReturnValue` (not `mockReturnValueOnce`) if the function is called multiple times. `validate-user-profile.js` `validateUserProfile()` is pure. Always mock `fs`, `js-yaml`, `config-resolver`, and dependency modules BEFORE requiring the module under test. `resolveConfig()` merges L1-L5, with L5 highest; `user_profile` is USER_FIELD; `toggleUserProfile()` flips bob<->advanced. `PermissionMode` and `OperationGuard` live in `.aios-core/core/permissions/`; `cycleMode()` and `enforcePermission()` wire through `index.js`. Modes: explore→ask→auto; `*yolo` works for all agents; badge comes from `_safeGetPermissionBadge()`.

Agent sources: `.aios-core/development/agents/`; mirror: `.claude/commands/AIOS/agents/`; `ideSync` syncs separately. Two formats exist: structured (`name: xxx`) and compact (`key: 'value'`). Compact: qa, devops, data-engineer, ux-design-expert. Always match existing format when editing.

Use `fs.writeFile(path, data, { flag: 'wx' })` for exclusive create lock - simpler and more testable than `fs.open('wx')`. Include PID + timestamp in lock data for stale detection. Stale threshold ~10s; lock timeout ~3s with polling at 50ms intervals. Temp file (`{path}.tmp.{pid}`) + `fs.rename()` pattern. Windows: `rename` fails if target exists -- fall back to direct `fs.writeFile()`. `.git/HEAD` mtime + `.git/index` mtime = cache fingerprint. `git rev-parse --git-dir` for worktree-aware git path. `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` to detect worktree vs main tree. When `writeFile` serves dual purpose (lock + cache), use broad `mockResolvedValue` and verify via `mock.calls` filtering. Mock `child_process.execSync` separately from `execa` (different modules). `jest.requireActual('fs')` for real filesystem checks in hook existence tests.

All section builders (`buildPresentation`, `buildRoleDescription`, `buildProjectStatus`, `buildFooter`, `buildContextSection`) now accept optional `sectionContext` param. `_buildContextualGreeting` creates `sectionContext` object from enriched pipeline context and passes to all builders. With context, existing/workflow presentation uses brief named greeting; otherwise archetypal. `_formatProjectStatusNarrative()` makes prose; `_formatProjectStatus()` is legacy. `_safeBuildSection(fn)` provides SECTION_TIMEOUT (150ms) and try/catch; context/workflow sections run in `Promise.all([contextSection, workflowSection])`. Footer: new `*guide`, existing `*help + *session-info`, workflow `Focused on **{story}**`. ACT-5 changes (lines 661-816 in greeting-builder.js) must NOT be touched -- they own workflow navigator section.

`VerificationGate`: `.aios-core/core/ids/verification-gate.js`; `CircuitBreaker`: `.aios-core/core/ids/circuit-breaker.js` (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN). Gates G1-G4 at `.aios-core/core/ids/gates/g{n}-*.js` - all compose with `IncrementalDecisionEngine.analyze()` (PUBLIC API only). G1/G2 advisory, G3 overridable soft block, G4 logged informational. `verify()` handles timeout, breaker, logging and delegates `_doVerify()`; failures degrade to warn/proceed, log/proceed, or skip. G3 needs `Boolean()` wrapper on override check: `false || "string"` evaluates to string in JS, not boolean. Jest `--testPathPattern` flag renamed to `--testPathPatterns` in newer Jest versions. Pre-existing test failure in `incremental-decision-engine.test.js` (non-string intent) -- unrelated to IDS-5a.

`RegistryHealer`: `.aios-core/core/ids/registry-healer.js`; six detectors, five healers. Reuses `computeChecksum` and `extractKeywords` from `populate-entity-registry.js` (DO NOT duplicate). Registry entities are nested by category: `registry.entities[category][entityId]` - need `buildEntityIndex()` to flatten. `NotificationManager`: `.aios-core/core/quality-gates/notification-manager.js` (console/file). Backups: `.aios-core/data/registry-backups/healing/`; JSONL audit: `.aios-core/data/registry-healing-log.jsonl`. `bin/aios-ids.js` is shared across IDS stories; linter may merge concurrent changes. DO NOT mock `populate-entity-registry.js` in tests - functions work on any filesystem path; just use `os.tmpdir()` temp dirs. `jest.mock()` path hoisting: cannot use `path.resolve()` in mock path argument because `jest.mock()` is hoisted before `const path = require('path')`.

`console.warn` with template literal is one argument, not two -- match with `stringContaining()` only. Existing `greeting-builder.test.js` mocks GreetingPreferenceManager globally returning 'auto' -- this means bob mode falls through to contextual path where redirect logic lives. Pre-existing lint errors (279 errors, 860 warnings) -- verify only your changed files lint clean. Use `os.tmpdir()` with unique suffixes for temp dirs in tests; cleanup with `fs.rmSync`. **CRITICAL**: `jest.clearAllMocks()` does NOT reset `mockImplementation()` -- only clears call history. If tests override `mockImplementation`, subsequent tests inherit the override. Fix: explicitly restore default mock implementations in `beforeEach`, or use `jest.restoreAllMocks()` (which only works with `jest.spyOn`). For `jest.mock()` factories, must manually re-apply defaults. When tests change mock constructors (e.g., `AgentConfigLoader.mockImplementation(...)`) and later tests need the default, the `pipeline` created in `beforeEach` will use whatever mock was active at construction time -- but runtime calls inside the pipeline (like `new SessionContextLoader()`) will use the CURRENT mock at call time.
